In the middle of all this, the Brady bunch - mum, dad and six children - live a happy and idyllic existence, caught in a time warp of 1970s values. But the family is in danger of losing the house, so it's up to the kids to pull together and raise the $20,000 needed to save their home.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Comedy horror based on the classic TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia and Christopher Lloyd. The ghoulish but happy Addams family are tricked out of their fortune when an impostor claims he's their long-lost Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Anjelica Huston and Raul Julia. The arrival of baby Pubert leads to some "deadly" games in the Addams household as the jealous Wednesday and Pugsley try to dispose of their new sibling. Morticia and Gomez hire Debbie as a nanny for the new arrival, and Debbie soon attracts the amorous attentions of Uncle Fester. But the nanny's motives prove to be even more sinister than the Addams clan itself.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and Ricardo Montalban. In the 23rd century, Admiral James T Kirk is a guest aboard the Enterprise, which is taking part in a training exercise. But the routine voyage becomes a serious mission when his old ship is lured into a deadly trap, placing Kirk and his companions at the mercy of a crazed adversary, the formidable Khan.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring William Shatner and DeForest Kelley. Barely surviving the wrath of Khan, the battle-scarred starship Enterprise limps back to Earth, saved only by the sacrifice of the late Captain Spock. However, the Vulcan's spirit is still with the crew, and back on the artificial Eden of the new Genesis planet his corpse is missing. Against orders, Admiral Kirk decides to lead the search for Spock and bring him home.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. In the 23rd century, Captain Kirk and his intrepid band of space travellers discover a probe in the vicinity of Earth that is trying to contact a humpback whale, a species that is extinct. In order to prevent the probe destroying the planet, Kirk and his crew visit 1986 San Francisco in order to locate two whales to take back to the future.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure based on the popular TV series, starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The captain and crew of the untested new starship Enterprise travel to the desolate world of Nimbus III after a Vulcan mystic kidnaps a group of Federation diplomats. There, they find themselves caught up in a dangerous quest.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The original crew of the Enterprise is given one final mission, to oversee the integration of the Klingons, who claim they want peace, into the intergalactic Federation. Initial hostility between the old adversaries is worsened by attacks against the Klingons from an unknown enemy within the Enterprise, and Kirk finds himself on the Klingons' home world, standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Star Trek: Generations
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and featuring William Shatner. When an evil alien threatens to destroy a star system along with millions of lives, Captain Jean-Luc Picard travels into a time vortex to enlist the help of his famous predecessor, James T Kirk.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Patrick Stewart. During a Federation encounter with the Borg, a sphere escapes into the Earth's past via a temporal vortex. Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise take up the challenge to pursue the Federation's most fearsome enemy and stop them from changing the future.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and Jonathan Frakes. The planet Ba'ku holds magical properties that keep the population young and living in harmony. So when an alien race attempts to take over this paradise, it falls to Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet and its people.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: Oscar-winning historical drama directed by and starring Mel Gibson. Scotland at the end of the 13th century: the young William Wallace sees his father and brother killed by the English. Later, when his sworn enemies execute his wife, Wallace leads the clans in the fight for Scottish independence.

programme.title: The Killing Fields
programme.desc: Biographical war drama starring Sam Waterston, Dr Haing S Ngor and John Malkovich. Cambodia, 1973: American journalist Sydney Schanberg and his guide Dith Pran are operating out of the war-torn ruins of Phnom Penh. When the Khmer Rouge armies enter the city, foreign reporters find themselves the target of hatred and are rounded up, facing the prospect of possible execution.

programme.title: Imitation of Life
programme.desc: Classic melodrama from director Douglas Sirk, starring Lana Turner. Aspiring actress Lora Meredith and her black housekeeper Annie Johnson both struggle to cope with the growing pains and problems of their daughters.

programme.title: Wild Horse Nine Interview Special
programme.desc: Writer/director Martin McDonagh and cast discuss the Film4-produced political comedy thriller Wild Horse Nine.

programme.title: Halls of Montezuma
programme.desc: Second World War action drama starring Richard Widmark. With US forces locked in a battle for supremacy against the Japanese in the South Pacific, a tough marine officer leads a patrol on a dangerous mission to capture enemy soldiers for interrogation.

programme.title: To Hell and Back
programme.desc: Biographical war drama starring Audie Murphy. Having spent his childhood in poverty in Texas, young Audie Murphy is turned down as physically unsuitable by the marines and the US Navy. Undeterred, he fights on to become the most decorated American soldier in the Second World War.

programme.title: Bridge of Spies Interview Special
programme.desc: Director Steven Spielberg and stars Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance talk about the making of the Cold War espionage drama

programme.title: Bridge of Spies
programme.desc: Spy thriller based on a true story, starring Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance. At the height of the Cold War, it falls to insurance lawyer James B Donovan to represent Soviet spy Rudolf Abel and broker a prisoner swap involving two American men - pilot Francis Gary Powers and student Frederic Pryor.

programme.title: Wrath of Man
programme.desc: Action thriller directed by Guy Ritchie and starring Jason Statham. A new employee working as a security guard for an armoured truck company proves his mettle during an attempted heist. His colleagues are impressed, and then increasingly suspicious about his skill set and motivation.

programme.title: Commando
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. Special Forces Colonel John Matrix retires to his mountain home and steadfastly refuses to return to active service. But when his daughter is kidnapped by South American revolutionaries, Matrix must undertake his most important mission - to rescue her.

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: Suspense thriller starring Morgan Freeman. Following the abduction of a senator's daughter, psychological profiler Alex Cross is forced to join the hunt when he's contacted by the kidnapper. Working closely with the agent responsible for security at the girl's school, Cross uncovers a disturbing conspiracy.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy

As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.desc:
Duggee is distracted from his newspaper because he must warn Roly not to spill his drink and tell Norrie not to drop crumbs; the Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess, so Duggee teaches them an important lesson. The Squirrels learn that there are certain dos and don'ts that you must follow in order to avoid mess or getting hurt, but that you can still have fun along the way.
Knowing why they should listen to these rules helps them understand their importance - if you spill your drink, someone could slip, and leftover crumbs can attract unwelcome guests. The Squirrels take turns suggesting their dos and don'ts, but some are a bit more niche than others. But most importantly, they remember that you do have fun with your friends!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc:
After watching the birds fly above them, the Squirrels discover that birds can also slide, run and lay eggs. This encourages them to learn more about the natural environment, and they discover how to do this responsibly with Duggee's five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, don't interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet.
The Squirrels embark on their own individual discoveries outside in rivers, the sea, mountains, the jungle and the desert. They learn how to spot an animal's disguise, better known as its camouflage. They see how birds may try to impress one another, which is in stark contrast to how a horned lizard uses its body to warn other creatures off. A fascinating look at nature!

Joining presenters Rav Wilding, Nick Stapleton and reporter Harleen Nottay, the actress and presenter tracks down the scammers trading on her name to con people out of money and helps victims pick up the pieces after their brush with the criminals

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When one of Nottingham's oldest businesses is broken into, staff member Becca turns Miss Marple and manages to crack the case. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan shows two residents of the doorbell detective neighbourhood the elaborate lengths thieves will go to, to get their hands on your stuff. And Matt also hears from two friends whose life savings disappeared overnight when their food truck was stolen.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman is in Gloucestershire with Sam and Mandy, who are moving from a harbour town in Devon and making a fresh start in the countryside, with their two much-loved dogs coming along for the adventure. Nicki also gets an invitation to experience horticulture on a truly regal scale when she visits a garden quite literally fit for a king

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Will Kirk and Kirsten Ramsay are in Dumfries and Galloway, where they help with a project to commemorate the victims of the Lockerbie bombing. Will is also joined by new automata expert Michael to tackle a clockwork train that was once the pride and joy of its owner's father and Kirsten learns the secrets of medieval slipware pottery from a pair of experts in the nearby village of Corsack

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Amanda, Jamie, Iain, Namita and Chris race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Vick Hope

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Oscar-winning horror mystery starring Daniel Kaluuya and Allison Williams. Chris, a young African-American photographer, is understandably anxious when he's invited to stay with his wealthy white girlfriend's parents at their family estate. Admitting she hasn't told them he's black only adds to Chris's apprehension, but mum and dad are warm and welcoming. However, as the weekend unfolds, Chris begins to suspect all is not as it seems.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: Cult mystery thriller starring Kyle MacLachlan, Isabella Rossellini, Dennis Hopper and Laura Dern. Jeffrey Beaumont's corner of small-town America is a pretty and peaceful place. But not far below the idyllic surface lies a dark and violent world, upon which young Jeffrey stumbles when following the trail of a severed ear.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce hosts the topical debate, with a panel of politicians and other guests facing questions from the audience in Exeter

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Martha is annoyed after Kurt takes all the credit for locating Kamilla, and vows to gain access to the scientist alone. Friedrich is ordered to ramp up his efforts to locate Greta, believing she is the key to the Hermann Metzl case. Eager for a win, Martha attempts to insinuate their way into Friedrich's confidence, and steals a prized possession

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Eric Knowles hosts as uncle and niece Russ and Lily on the red team and twin sisters Angie and Tamsin on the blue team scour an antiques fair in Southwell, Nottinghamshire for items to sell for profit at auction. With just 60 minutes to buy three items, Russ makes an early pit stop at a stall selling boxed toy cars and a marcasite brooch catches the sisters' attention

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. With a loss of sea ice, many animals are now weakening, driving animals to adapt in surprising ways, from green sea urchins using discarded shells as sun hats to common seals moving further north, only to provide unfamiliar prey for a young polar bear

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Manchester United at Anfield and Hull City v Brighton & Hove Albion at MKM Stadium. United did the double over their rivals last term for the first time since the 2015/16 season, but have struggled for form so far this term. Elsewhere, the high-flying Seagulls took on a Hull side who had acquitted themselves well to life back in the top flight. Plus, a round-up of yesterday's goals

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: A team of family and friends, Amy, JP, Nic and Alan, take on the Bridge of Lies, they must cross the Bridge, stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies. Hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray discovers a brown sauce revival and the advantages of getting fish from a fishmonger as he visits Londonderry's Walled City Market. Briony-May Williams explores how Somerset is rivalling France in cheese productions, and Onkar Singh Purewal discovers the secrets of beekeeping

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo sets off from Tynemouth on the first leg of a trip to Berwick-upon-Tweed, hearing about of a 19th-century tragedy at sea that inspired 140 local men to set up a coastal rescue service. At Long Sands beach, Michael rolls up his sleeves to help volunteers caring for sick and injured seals at the Tynemouth Aquarium Seal Hospital

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: Storm Arwen hits the UK and the skippers have tough decisions to make. Boats start to roll in the North Sea, putting Victory Rose and Our Lass at risk of collision. Skipper Darren has just three days of crabbing time before the storm pushes the boat back to the harbour and George Jack considers venturing in to the storm in search of a new species of prawn

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team pay a return visit to Coughton Court in Warwickshire. Among the finds brought in by the public are a letter from Agatha Christie, a medal awarded to those who came to the aid of the Titanic survivors, and a rare china figure of the Queen on horseback

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon travel to the Oxford Union, where they pick out antiques and collectibles to be sold at a local auction - including an autograph book and some etchings by a famous artist. Plus, Paul goes behind the scenes at the venue, to discover which famous faces debated in the chamber

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Michael Sheen is joined by Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad, who compete in a series of fun trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor chats to the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition, while Friday's all-star panel look back at the weekend action from the Tower Ballroom in Blackpool

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: Nomsa Maseko reports from South Africa, where a series of shocking murders has exposed the dangers that women face. Plus, new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences, whlle BBC Urdu joins women in Pakistan challenging traditional barriers by taking to the road on motorbikes, gaining new independence in a country where riding has long been considered off-limits to many women

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Clive Myrie invites four more contestants to brave the black chair, from which they answer questions on their specialist subjects of actress Marilyn Monroe, author Katherine Mansfield, award-winning TV series The Sopranos and German mathematician Carl Friedrich Gauss. They are then tested on their general knowledge

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts as the Six Sevens take on Meat and Two Veg for a place in the quarter-finals. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues asking what connects Toe Martin, Shadow Fury, Tonsil Draper, and Jiminy Stokes

programme.title: University Challenge
programme.desc: Amol Rajan asks the questions as the second round of the student quiz continues, with the University of Bristol pitting their wits against near neighbours the University of Bath for a place in the quarter-finals

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: The historian uncovers the untold stories of incredible palaces and the people who lived there, beginning by travelling to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages

programme.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
programme.desc: Lee and Sarah keep a careful watch as people spill out of the pubs and clubs of Portadown, where Stephen is harangued by a man, but sends the trouble-maker packing. Back in Belfast, Jade, Tom, Perri and Adam spot an argument outside shops, where young people say their money has been stolen by a woman

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day, presented by Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: Blood
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Paul Bettany and Stephen Graham. When the prime suspect in the murder of a schoolgirl is released, two sibling cops decide to emulate their retired police chief father by doling out their own form of retribution. But their actions are destined to come back to haunt them.

programme.desc: The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. With a loss of sea ice, many animals are now weakening, driving animals to adapt in surprising ways, from green sea urchins using discarded shells as sun hats to common seals moving further north, only to provide unfamiliar prey for a young polar bear

programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Manchester United at Anfield and Hull City v Brighton & Hove Albion at MKM Stadium. programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: A team of family and friends, Amy, JP, Nic and Alan, take on the Bridge of Lies, they must cross the Bridge, stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies. Hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.desc: Colin Murray discovers a brown sauce revival and the advantages of getting fish from a fishmonger as he visits Londonderry's Walled City Market. Briony-May Williams explores how Somerset is rivalling France in cheese productions, and Onkar Singh Purewal discovers the secrets of beekeeping

programme.desc: Michael Portillo sets off from Tynemouth on the first leg of a trip to Berwick-upon-Tweed, hearing about of a 19th-century tragedy at sea that inspired 140 local men to set up a coastal rescue service. At Long Sands beach, Michael rolls up his sleeves to help volunteers caring for sick and injured seals at the Tynemouth Aquarium Seal Hospital

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: Storm Arwen hits the UK and the skippers have tough decisions to make. Boats start to roll in the North Sea, putting Victory Rose and Our Lass at risk of collision. Skipper Darren has just three days of crabbing time before the storm pushes the boat back to the harbour and George Jack considers venturing in to the storm in search of a new species of prawn

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team pay a return visit to Coughton Court in Warwickshire. Among the finds brought in by the public are a letter from Agatha Christie, a medal awarded to those who came to the aid of the Titanic survivors, and a rare china figure of the Queen on horseback

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon travel to the Oxford Union, where they pick out antiques and collectibles to be sold at a local auction - including an autograph book and some etchings by a famous artist. Plus, Paul goes behind the scenes at the venue, to discover which famous faces debated in the chamber

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Michael Sheen is joined by Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad, who compete in a series of fun trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor chats to the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition, while Friday's all-star panel look back at the weekend action from the Tower Ballroom in Blackpool

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: Nomsa Maseko reports from South Africa, where a series of shocking murders has exposed the dangers that women face. Plus, new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences, whlle BBC Urdu joins women in Pakistan challenging traditional barriers by taking to the road on motorbikes, gaining new independence in a country where riding has long been considered off-limits to many women

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Clive Myrie invites four more contestants to brave the black chair, from which they answer questions on their specialist subjects of actress Marilyn Monroe, author Katherine Mansfield, award-winning TV series The Sopranos and German mathematician Carl Friedrich Gauss. They are then tested on their general knowledge

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts as the Six Sevens take on Meat and Two Veg for a place in the quarter-finals. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues asking what connects Toe Martin, Shadow Fury, Tonsil Draper, and Jiminy Stokes

programme.title: University Challenge
programme.desc: Amol Rajan asks the questions as the second round of the student quiz continues, with the University of Bristol pitting their wits against near neighbours the University of Bath for a place in the quarter-finals

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: The historian uncovers the untold stories of incredible palaces and the people who lived there, beginning by travelling to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages

programme.title: Ceolta
programme.desc: Fiachna Ó Braonáin and Eve Belle introduce a selection of traditional music from the Court House in Bangor, Co Down, featuring 1990s rockers Hothouse Flowers. Also taking to the stage are And So I Watch You From Afar and Winnie Ama. In Irish

programme.title: Newsnight

But their actions are destined to come back to haunt them.

programme.desc: A woman explaining her chest pains to the paramedics suddenly goes into cardiac arrest. A young boy has the tell-tale signs of croup, and a young man suffers an allergic reaction after drinking an alcoholic chilli shot

programme.title: A Friend of the Family
programme.desc: Flashbacks reveal how the Berchtolds and Brobergs grew closer. But as Mary Ann and the girls fall under the spell of their fun-loving neighbour, Bob comes to see him as a threat

programme.title: A Friend of the Family

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa takes up ice hockey and proves so good at the game that she completely transforms her ailing team's fortunes. Dismayed at being outshone by a girl, Bart tries to compensate by becoming a teacher's pet - only to be beaten up by bullies

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer and Marge attend a confectionery convention, where they plan to make off with lots of free sweets. Unfortunately, Homer's love of candy results in him being wrongly accused of sexual harassment by the family's babysitter and smeared by the media. programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer meet Amber and Martin Brammah in Waterbeach, Cambridgeshire, who are undecided on whether they should sell their home or completely renovate it. Amber owns a fitness company and runs classes from home, and feels a bigger property would be better for her business. However, Martin feels that it would be better to use their budget to renovate their current family home

programme.desc: Frasier persuades Cliff to undergo a course of electric-shock therapy as a means of making friends and influencing people. Kelsey Grammer and John Ratzenberger star

programme.desc: In a feeble attempt to prove their masculinity, Norm, Woody and Cliff pretend they've been skydiving - but a revelation from Rebecca makes Sam decide to take the plunge for real. Comedy, starring Ted Danson

programme.desc: Doug and Deacon try their luck on the gaming tables in Atlantic City, telling Carrie a white lie to ensure there is no trouble at home - but their night proves far from profitable. Kevin James and Victor Williams star

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug reveals his benevolent side when he decides to become a mentor to an underprivileged child, but is disappointed with the boy assigned to him. Meanwhile, Carrie has to explain to a partner in her law firm why she declared her love for him over the phone. Kevin James and Leah Remini star

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug is duped by his neighbour into buying a water filtration device. He is drawn deeper into trouble when he signs up to be a licensed seller and needs to find 10 more salesmen to follow in his footsteps to recoup his investment. Comedy, starring Kevin James

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Robert is injured in the line of duty and Ray realises he is partly responsible. Unfortunately his bedside manner leaves a lot to be desired, until he grudgingly agrees to Debra's demand to tell his brother how much he cares for him. Comedy, starring Ray Romano, Brad Garrett and Patricia Heaton

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra is angry to discover Ray recorded a Super Bowl game over their wedding video, and forces him to renew his marriage vows as a way of making amends. Comedy, starring Ray Romano and Patricia Heaton

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray's efforts to take an interest in one of Ally's hobbies backfire, leaving him searching for a particularly rare trading card to make amends. American comedy, starring Ray Romano, Madylin Sweeten and Patricia Heaton

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Niles puts Daphne on a diet, unaware she has secret stashes of food hidden all over the place. Roz tries a new perfume guaranteed to have a devastating effect on men, while Frasier sets out to save station manager Kenny's marriage - only to end up dating his wife

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Niles attends a Seattle SuperSonics basketball game with Frasier, where he is plucked out of the crowd at random and offered a big cash prize to sink a half-court shot. David Hyde Pierce stars

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Roz asks Frasier to narrate her documentary on the history of space travel - but he makes such a hash of it she ends up getting rid of him and recruiting former astronaut John Glenn instead. Meanwhile, Niles tries to relive his childhood by entering a kite-flying competition

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Niles and Frasier search for a wealthy patron prepared to give their old school a much-needed cash injection, and soon find the ideal candidate - Martin's new girlfriend. Comedy, starring Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce, with Barbara Babcock (Hill Street Blues)

programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay travels across the United States in search of restaurants in dire need of renovation - and after analysing their situation, he has just 24 hours to bring them back from the brink of disaster. programme.title: Victor Frankenstein

While visiting a circus in London, obsessive scientist Victor Frankenstein rescues a hunchback who is enslaved by the owner, names him Igor and employs him to assist with his experiments into the creation of life. But when Frankenstein's work falls foul of the authorities, Igor must try to pull him back from the brink of madness.

They join him in a quest to find the seven lords of Telmar - loyal friends of his father who were forced into exile by his evil uncle.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure based on a story by Hans Christian Andersen, featuring the voices of Jodi Benson and René Auberjonois. programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: Animated science-fiction adventure based on Robert Louis Stevenson's classic novel, Treasure Island. Joining a space galleon as a cabin boy, he sets off on an intergalactic voyage of discovery, under the watchful eye of mysterious cyborg cook John Silver.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: For centuries, people have called out to the universe looking for answers. In this fun-filled, action-packed feature film from Disney and Pixar, the universe calls back! The cosmic adventure introduces Elio, a space fanatic with an active imagination and a huge alien obsession. So, when he's beamed up to the Communiverse, an interplanetary organization with representatives from galaxies far and wide, Elio's all in for the epic undertaking. Mistakenly identified as Earth's leader, Elio must form new bonds with eccentric alien life-forms, navigate a crisis of intergalactic proportions, and somehow discover who and where he is truly meant to be.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: Animated musical drama, based on Victor Hugo's classic tale, featuring the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline. Fifteenth-century Paris: when his father is arrested and mother killed, Quasimodo is raised in the solitude of Notre Dame cathedral's bell tower. Hidden from the world by his guardian Claude Frollo, the Minister for Justice, he is taken pity on by a gypsy girl called Esmeralda.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie

Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: At Golitha Falls, where the River Fowey tumbles down to the sea, Rick meets Dawn French, who has made Cornwall her home. In the shadow of Devonport Dockyard, he boards the world's busiest chain ferry to cross the wide River Tamar, the ancient watery boundary between Devon and Cornwall - along the way discovering an unusual event involving circus elephant. And he meets a man who thinks he has discovered the next superfood, which Rick used to cook up a delicious duck dish

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick heads into the county's china clay pits to discover what is known locally as white gold, one of its most important industries. He then climbs the Cornish Alps, huge slag heaps created by the clay mining and some of Cornwall's highest land. After a wild swim at one of Cornwall's picturesque hidden coves, Rick cooks a simple sea bass recipe, revealing how to make the perfect mayonnaise. In the far west of the county, on the Land's End peninsula, Rick meets his niece, a modern artist, who explains her deep spiritual connection to Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the post-war British modern art movement in the seaside town of St Ives, the home for leading artists such as Barbara Hepworth and Terry Frost. At the Lizard Peninsula, Rick heads out to sea to fish for red mullet, and on the wild coast at Land's End, he discovers why Cornwall has a rather unusual animal as its national emblem

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the Roseland Peninsula, beginning at a spot believed by some to have been visited by Jesus Christ. He tours the bay of St Mawes with Alex and Olga Polizzi, who own one of Cornwall's most luxurious hotels, and meets one of the county's oldest butchers, who demonstrates the ancient practice of aging meat. Finally, in the harbourside village of Mousehole, Rick meets a potter who finds inspiration from the local landscape

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers forage for food, exploring Britain's fields and hedgerows in search of free ingredients that will form the basis of spectacular dishes

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales embark on a journey into their pasts via the Leeds and Liverpool Canal, which celebrated its 200th anniversary in 2016. Along the way, they visit the country's last surviving steam-powered textile mill, meander through the 'curlies', and meet acclaimed poet Simon Armitage. They also take a trip by steam train to the home of the Bronte sisters in Haworth, and are confronted by the Salts Mill after tackling the steepest lock staircase in Britain

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson tackles the longest racetrack in the world, Germany's Nurburgring, and actor Christian Slater is the Star in a Reasonably Priced Car. James May marks the 50th birthday of the Mercedes 300SL, one of the most revered cars ever made, and Richard Hammond celebrates 20 years of the Renault Espace

programme.title: Guy Martin vs the Robot Car
programme.desc: The presenter explores the world of automated self-driving vehicles, attempting to build one of his own in his shed. He takes a trip to Budapest for a ride in a completely autonomous vehicle, which is being tested on public roads for the first time. Finally, he heads to Silverstone, to take on a computer-controlled car in a race

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: At Golitha Falls, where the River Fowey tumbles down to the sea, Rick meets Dawn French, who has made Cornwall her home. In the shadow of Devonport Dockyard, he boards the world's busiest chain ferry to cross the wide River Tamar, the ancient watery boundary between Devon and Cornwall - along the way discovering an unusual event involving circus elephant. And he meets a man who thinks he has discovered the next superfood, which Rick used to cook up a delicious duck dish

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick heads into the county's china clay pits to discover what is known locally as white gold, one of its most important industries. He then climbs the Cornish Alps, huge slag heaps created by the clay mining and some of Cornwall's highest land. After a wild swim at one of Cornwall's picturesque hidden coves, Rick cooks a simple sea bass recipe, revealing how to make the perfect mayonnaise. In the far west of the county, on the Land's End peninsula, Rick meets his niece, a modern artist, who explains her deep spiritual connection to Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the post-war British modern art movement in the seaside town of St Ives, the home for leading artists such as Barbara Hepworth and Terry Frost. At the Lizard Peninsula, Rick heads out to sea to fish for red mullet, and on the wild coast at Land's End, he discovers why Cornwall has a rather unusual animal as its national emblem

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the Roseland Peninsula, beginning at a spot believed by some to have been visited by Jesus Christ. He tours the bay of St Mawes with Alex and Olga Polizzi, who own one of Cornwall's most luxurious hotels, and meets one of the county's oldest butchers, who demonstrates the ancient practice of aging meat. Finally, in the harbourside village of Mousehole, Rick meets a potter who finds inspiration from the local landscape

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: At Golitha Falls, where the River Fowey tumbles down to the sea, Rick meets Dawn French, who has made Cornwall her home. In the shadow of Devonport Dockyard, he boards the world's busiest chain ferry to cross the wide River Tamar, the ancient watery boundary between Devon and Cornwall - along the way discovering an unusual event involving circus elephant. And he meets a man who thinks he has discovered the next superfood, which Rick used to cook up a delicious duck dish

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick heads into the county's china clay pits to discover what is known locally as white gold, one of its most important industries. He then climbs the Cornish Alps, huge slag heaps created by the clay mining and some of Cornwall's highest land. After a wild swim at one of Cornwall's picturesque hidden coves, Rick cooks a simple sea bass recipe, revealing how to make the perfect mayonnaise. In the far west of the county, on the Land's End peninsula, Rick meets his niece, a modern artist, who explains her deep spiritual connection to Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the post-war British modern art movement in the seaside town of St Ives, the home for leading artists such as Barbara Hepworth and Terry Frost. At the Lizard Peninsula, Rick heads out to sea to fish for red mullet, and on the wild coast at Land's End, he discovers why Cornwall has a rather unusual animal as its national emblem

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the Roseland Peninsula, beginning at a spot believed by some to have been visited by Jesus Christ. He tours the bay of St Mawes with Alex and Olga Polizzi, who own one of Cornwall's most luxurious hotels, and meets one of the county's oldest butchers, who demonstrates the ancient practice of aging meat. Finally, in the harbourside village of Mousehole, Rick meets a potter who finds inspiration from the local landscape

programme.desc: Following on from the three-part drama about the serial killer Dennis Nilsen, this documentary explores the personality of the man behind the crimes - on the surface a mild-mannered civil servant who admitted to murdering up to 15 young men over a four-year period in the late 1980s and early 1980s, disposing of their bodies in the garden and down the drain. The film includes footage of an interview Nilsen gave to ITV at Albany Prison in 1992, contributions from victims' families and insights from criminologist David Wilson, who corresponded with Nilsen over several decades. Narrated by David Tennant

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: The Luftwaffe's bombing raids on Britain's provincial cities, when Coventry and Plymouth were hardest hit, although Portsmouth, Glasgow, Sheffield and Bristol also suffered heavy casualties. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: War Factories

programme.title: Incredible Journeys with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon recalls some of the most dangerous experiences of his travels, from coming under fire in war-torn Mogadishu to squaring off with a female wrestler in Mexico City. Among the past destinations featured are a police cell in the far east of Russia, and the programme also looks back at his encounters with ambulance crews in San Salvador and anti-smuggling police in Italy

programme.title: Simon Reeve's South America
programme.desc: On the fourth leg of his journey through the continent, Simon travels through three of the world's most extreme environments as he takes in the salt flats of Bolivia, Brazil's Pantanal wetland region and Paraguay's Chaco Forest. In Bolivia, he meets a family making a living carving salt from the vast white expanse of the Uyuni flats, while in Brazil he has a close encounter with South America's apex predator, the jaguar. In Paraguay, Simon visits a Mennonites school, where traditionally clothed children are drilled in Bible texts and there are no smartphones to be seen

programme.title: Sacred Rivers with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: The adventurer travels to China for a trip along the Yangtze, Asia's longest river and the third longest in the world. He follows the route to Dazu, where he sees 50,000 ancient rock carvings, some of the only religious artefacts not to have been destroyed under communist rule. He then takes a river cruise to the Three Gorges Dam - the biggest power station on the planet - before ending his journey in Shanghai, a shining symbol of China's new economic might and a city where many are rediscovering religious faith

programme.title: Bangers & Cash

programme.title: Blood
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Paul Bettany and Stephen Graham. When the prime suspect in the murder of a schoolgirl is released, two sibling cops decide to emulate their retired police chief father by doling out their own form of retribution. But their actions are destined to come back to haunt them.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police investigate the disappearance of a young monk from a monastery on a remote private island in Orkney and the mystery deepens when there appears to be no evidence of how he could have left the island. programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters

This documentary uses the scandal as a starting point to explore infamous Satanic panic cases, a type of moral hysteria fuelled by overzealous law enforcement, unsubstantiated statements from children and suggestive interrogation by therapists and prosecutors

programme.desc: The return of the documentary series that follows the investigations of specialist units within UK police forces created to crack the toughest of cases, from cyber heists, romance fraud and people trafficking to drug rings and murder. With access to some of Britain’s most talented detectives, the series explores the investigations, methods and evidence that has put some of the UK’s most dangerous criminals behind bars. Each episode features 'evidential police footage' as they take on criminals and hunt for clues to solve the cases. The series offers a first-hand experience of the work of the elite units on the front line while witnessing their bravery, skill and compassion amid tragedy and loss. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Clare Collier from Cambridge brings in a sweet reminder of her childhood, for the attention of clock restorer Steve Fletcher. The art deco chiming clock belonged to her great-grandmother. The mischievous old lady would leave secret sweets on the clock for Clare and her sister at bedtime. The clock has been silent for over 25 years, and the wooden casing is dull and dirty. Steve gives the mechanism a good soak and scrub up, then carefully reassembles all the workings, getting it ticking and chiming once again. Will gives the woodwork a spruce up and crafts a few wooden sweeties for the top, much to Clare's delight.
John McMuldroch from Merseyside is here to see bear repair duo Julie Tatchell and Amanda Middleditch, accompanied by his late mother's beloved teddy bear. John's mother Joan was a big part of his life, and the bear was very special to her. At the age of 65, the bear is now in dire need of the bear ladies' attention. His limbs are loose, his paws damaged and his growler no longer works. Amanda and Julie lovingly take him apart, remove the old stuffing, then cleverly reconstruct his paws and replace the growler so that he can greet John on his return.
Angela Hodge from Rochester brings a treasure trove of memories for silversmith and vintage camera enthusiast Brenton West. The 3D photo viewer was her mother's and was used to display wonderful 3D images of her wedding day in 1958. Sadly the glass screen is now cracked and many of the slides are damaged, rendering it inoperable. Angela lost her mother recently, and she would love to get a glimpse of her parents on their special day. Brenton goes to work restoring the vintage viewer using ingenious replacements for the battery power source and the tiny lightbulb that illuminates the magical images.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and Ricardo Montalban. In the 23rd century, Admiral James T Kirk is a guest aboard the Enterprise, which is taking part in a training exercise. But the routine voyage becomes a serious mission when his old ship is lured into a deadly trap, placing Kirk and his companions at the mercy of a crazed adversary, the formidable Khan.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Revenge
programme.desc: Some films are best served cold, so wrap up and join us as we dive into our favourite revenge movies - from new hits to Oscar-winning classics. We hope you're ready for action.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring William Shatner and DeForest Kelley. Barely surviving the wrath of Khan, the battle-scarred starship Enterprise limps back to Earth, saved only by the sacrifice of the late Captain Spock. However, the Vulcan's spirit is still with the crew, and back on the artificial Eden of the new Genesis planet his corpse is missing. Against orders, Admiral Kirk decides to lead the search for Spock and bring him home.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. In the 23rd century, Captain Kirk and his intrepid band of space travellers discover a probe in the vicinity of Earth that is trying to contact a humpback whale, a species that is extinct. In order to prevent the probe destroying the planet, Kirk and his crew visit 1986 San Francisco in order to locate two whales to take back to the future.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure based on the popular TV series, starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The captain and crew of the untested new starship Enterprise travel to the desolate world of Nimbus III after a Vulcan mystic kidnaps a group of Federation diplomats. There, they find themselves caught up in a dangerous quest.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The original crew of the Enterprise is given one final mission, to oversee the integration of the Klingons, who claim they want peace, into the intergalactic Federation. Initial hostility between the old adversaries is worsened by attacks against the Klingons from an unknown enemy within the Enterprise, and Kirk finds himself on the Klingons' home world, standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Star Trek: Generations
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and featuring William Shatner. When an evil alien threatens to destroy a star system along with millions of lives, Captain Jean-Luc Picard travels into a time vortex to enlist the help of his famous predecessor, James T Kirk.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Patrick Stewart. During a Federation encounter with the Borg, a sphere escapes into the Earth's past via a temporal vortex. Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise take up the challenge to pursue the Federation's most fearsome enemy and stop them from changing the future.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and Jonathan Frakes. The planet Ba'ku holds magical properties that keep the population young and living in harmony. So when an alien race attempts to take over this paradise, it falls to Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet and its people.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: James Cameron's science-fiction action thriller sequel to The Terminator, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Linda Hamilton. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Tommy Lee Jones and Will Smith. When a New York police officer is recruited by a top-secret agency that monitors alien activity he finds himself in a race against time to save the Earth from destruction.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: Comedy starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. With the children now able to walk and talk, the Ubriacco family acquire a mongrel puppy, Rocks. As the Christmas season approaches the family's usual struggles are complicated by the unexpected gift of Daphne, a pampered poodle.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Steve Buscemi, Maggie Gyllenhaal and Kathleen Turner. With Halloween approaching, three kids attempt to unlock a haunted house's dark secrets before it swallows up unsuspecting trick-or-treaters.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from Monster Family to The Amazing Maurice.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, with the voices of Julia Sawalha, Jane Horrocks, Miranda Richardson and Mel Gibson. A clutch of hens, led by head chick Ginger, suffers life on a grim 1950s egg farm. When the avaricious owners decide to move into the meat-pie business, the chickens fear the worst. With the help of American rooster Rocky, the birds start to plan a prisoner-of-war-style escape.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure based on the popular TV series. Tommy Pickles is feeling forced out by his new baby brother who just makes too much noise. But when Tommy hatches a plan to return his sibling to the hospital, it leads to some unexpected adventures.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bruce Willis and Chrissie Hynde. Young Tommy Pickles gets the opportunity to meet his nature-documentary hero Sir Nigel Thornberry, after his family vacation goes awry. Stranded on a desert island, the baby and his pals think they're alone, until they encounter the Thornberry clan filming their latest animal epic.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, Chris Rock and David Schwimmer. A zebra called Marty tries to escape his comfortable existence at the Central Park Zoo and return to the wild. Accompanying him, albeit reluctantly, are Alex the lion, a neurotic giraffe and a no-nonsense hippo.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, David Schwimmer and Chris Rock. The escaped animals from Central Park Zoo - Alex the Lion, Melman the Giraffe, Marty the Zebra and Gloria the Hippo - try to fly back from Madagascar but are forced down in the wilds of Africa, where they soon encounter some familiar faces.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: When Papa Smurf is taken by evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel, Smurfette leads her fellow blue creatures on a mission to the real world to save him. Live-action animated musical fantasy comedy, featuring the voices of Rihanna, James Corden and Nick Offerman

programme.title: A Good Year
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Russell Crowe and Albert Finney. When ruthless city trader Max Skinner inherits a vineyard in Provence, he has difficulty adapting to his new life.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Jason Lee as a struggling Los Angeles songwriter whose fortunes change when he accidentally brings home a trio of singing chipmunks called Alvin, Simon and Theodore. Together they achieve worldwide success, but it's not long before they discover that the music industry has a shady side.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Justin Long and Jason Lee. Singing sensations Alvin, Simon and Theodore have to put aside their glittering career to face up to the reality of studying. But they and their new musical rivals, The Chipettes, must put their pop prowess to use in order to save the school's music programme by winning a battle of the bands competition.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure starring Jason Lee. High jinks while aboard a cruise liner leads to Alvin and his chipmunk pals being stranded on a remote island. But survival in this jungle paradise proves to be harder than they expected.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
