programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Bad Boys for Life
programme.desc: Comedy thriller starring Will Smith and Martin Lawrence. When a figure from the past returns and targets detective Mike Lowery for assassination, he and partner Marcus Burnett are forced to fight back - curtailing Burnett's retirement plans. But things aren't all they seem, and it gradually becomes clear that Lowery may have an even deeper connection with their assailant.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Thriller starring Jason Statham. A troubled former soldier on the run from a court martial assumes another man's identity and goes into hiding on the streets of London. But the desire to avenge injustice is something he can never leave behind.

programme.title: The Legend of Tarzan
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Alexander Skarsgård, Samuel L Jackson and Margot Robbie. Tarzan, now living in England as Lord Greystoke, returns to the Congo to investigate a slave trader.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Christmas Laughs
programme.desc: It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas! From Nativity! to Office Christmas Party, get into the festive spirit with this week's Christmas laughs Cinema List

programme.title: Demolition Man
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Sylvester Stallone, Wesley Snipes and Sandra Bullock. After failing to defuse a situation where villainous Simon Phoenix has taken 30 people hostage, Los Angeles Police sergeant John Spartan, known as the "Demolition Man", stands jointly accused of their manslaughter and the pair are imprisoned and frozen in a cryo penitentiary. When Phoenix escapes several decades later, Spartan is woken and sent to apprehend his old enemy in the futuristic city of San Angeles.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker and Vin Diesel. When illegal street racer Dominic Toretto is suspected of being the mastermind behind a series of truck hijacks, undercover police officer Brian O'Conner is sent to infiltrate his gang. But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: Enter the Dragon
programme.desc: Classic martial arts adventure starring Bruce Lee. A master of martial arts is enlisted by British intelligence to help put an end to the traffic in opium and sex workers organised from an island fortress by a criminal mastermind.

programme.title: Snakes on a Plane
programme.desc: Action horror thriller starring Samuel L Jackson and Julianna Margulies. Grizzled FBI agent Neville Flynn is accompanying Mob murder witness Sean Jones on a flight from from Hawaii to Los Angeles, where Jones is due to testify against brutal crime boss Eddie Kim. But the aircraft holds a concealed cargo of lethal, aggressive reptiles.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker and Vin Diesel. When illegal street racer Dominic Toretto is suspected of being the mastermind behind a series of truck hijacks, undercover police officer Brian O'Conner is sent to infiltrate his gang. But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Idris Elba. Bickering agents Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw are paired up to track down a deadly supervirus that has been stolen by terrorist Brixton Lore. But Lore is no ordinary villain - he has been implanted with cybernetic technology that gives him superhuman strength.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Enter the Dragon
programme.desc: Classic martial arts adventure starring Bruce Lee. A master of martial arts is enlisted by British intelligence to help put an end to the traffic in opium and sex workers organised from an island fortress by a criminal mastermind.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Elijah Wood. Mumble and his son Erik must rescue their friends and family in the aftermath of a natural disaster.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, featuring the voices of Martin Lawrence and Ashton Kutcher. In a tranquil mountain town, domesticated grizzly bear Boog enjoys an idyllic life as the star of a wildlife show. But when he meets hyperactive deer Elliot, he gets into so much trouble that his keeper decides it's time to release him back into the wild. Problem is, hunting season is fast approaching and there's a tenacious hunter who's determined to bag both Boog and Elliot.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Misguided inventor Flint Lockwood creates a machine that can turn water into food. But what initially seems like the answer to his community's economic crisis soon begins to cause some unexpected problems.

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy with the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Flint Lockwood's mutating machine is no longer turning water into food but producing food/animal hybrids, or foodimals, which very quickly overrun his home town.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig and Trey Parker. Having already acquired a wife and three orphan daughters, reformed supervillain Gru now discovers that he has a long-lost twin, Dru. But Dru is hoping he can convince his brother to return to his wicked ways...

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Sandra Bullock. The film charts the history of the diminutive yellow sidekicks as they seek to serve the biggest villains around - everyone from Dracula to Napoleon, all the way up to their introduction to Gru, their evil leader in Despicable Me.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Alec Baldwin. When a seven-year-old boy discovers that his baby brother is a spy on a secret mission, he joins forces with his suit-wearing, briefcase-carrying sibling to defeat an evil businessman.

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Woody Allen, Sharon Stone, Sylvester Stallone and Gene Hackman. In an ant hill that contains millions of inhabitants, neurotic worker ant Z has trouble conforming to the regimented way of life. But his mundane existence is changed for ever when he meets the beautiful Princess Bala and becomes involved in the sinister plans of power-mad General Mandible.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kerwin Mathews. Blown off course to the monster-infested island of Colossa, Sinbad and his crew rescue a sorcerer from the clutches of a cyclops. The voyage continues to Baghdad, but the sorcerer has been forced to leave stolen property behind, and hatches a wicked plan to force Sinbad to return to Colossa.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Sports drama starring Tom Cruise, Robert Duvall and Nicole Kidman. Cocky racing driver Cole Trickle is revved up to take the stock-car circuit by storm, but his aggressive driving style soon lands him in hospital. There he meets Dr Claire Lewicki, who gives the young driver more than racing to think about.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: James Cameron's science-fiction action thriller sequel to The Terminator, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Linda Hamilton. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Tommy Lee Jones and Will Smith. When a New York police officer is recruited by a top-secret agency that monitors alien activity he finds himself in a race against time to save the Earth from destruction.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic sci-fi adventure, starring Henry Thomas and Dee Wallace, and featuring Drew Barrymore. Ten-year-old Elliott has a new friend, but he's from another planet and nobody must know he's here.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: Song Sung Blue
programme.desc: Musical drama based on a true story, starring Hugh Jackman and Kate Hudson. In the late 1980s, struggling Milwaukee musician Mike Sardina and part-time performer Claire Stengl find success - and love - when they team up to form a Neil Diamond tribute act named Lightning and Thunder. However, after a tragic accident threatens their livelihood, the couple fight to hold on to their dream.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Oscar-winning melodrama starring Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger and Jack Nicholson. Aurora Greenway is an attractive widow whose main problems in life are fending off an alarming number of suitors and keeping her headstrong daughter Emma in check. But as the years pass by, Aurora's attitude to life and love, and her relationship with her daughter, begin to change.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: I, Tonya
programme.desc: Comedy drama based on a true story, starring Margot Robbie and Sebastian Stan. Figure skater Tonya Harding defies her detractors to rise to the top only to suffer an ignominious fall when she becomes embroiled in a plot to attack her rival, Nancy Kerrigan.

programme.title: Song Sung Blue

programme.desc: Adventure drama starring Tom Hanks and Helen Hunt. Workaholic executive Chuck Noland is looking forward to spending Christmas with his girlfriend, but is sent abroad on an assignment at the last minute. When his plane crashes into the Pacific, Chuck is stranded alone on a remote, uninhabited island.

programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a chilling turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening phone messages during their dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming suitor is behind the harassment. Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: Two rivals fight for control of a major crime family. Director Barry Levinson's drama based on true events, starring Robert De Niro, Cosmo Jarvis and Debra Messing

programme.title: Strung
programme.desc: A talented violinist whose new job tutoring for an elite family turns into a battle for safety and sanity when she realises her past is linked to the family's patriarch. Thriller, starring Chloe Bailey, Lynn Whitfield and Lucien Laviscount

programme.title: Borderline
programme.desc: A bodyguard protects a pop superstar and her athlete boyfriend from a determined stalker in 1990s Los Angeles. Director Jimmy Warden's dark comedy horror, starring Samara Weaving and Ray Nicholson

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Jason Statham and Paddy Considine. When a serial killer known as the "Blitz" begins to target policemen, it's left up to loose-cannon, no-nonsense cop Tom Brant to catch the villain. But as the killings continue, Brant's maverick methods of policing increasingly come into conflict with the by-the-book approach of his new boss, Nash.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Horror remake starring Jane Levy, Shiloh Fernandez and Lou Taylor Pucci. Four friends decamp to an isolated cabin in the woods to help drug addict Mia kick her habit. However, when one of them quotes from an ancient book of the dead, the forces of hell are unleashed and no one is safe.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Horror adventure starring Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube and Jon Voight. In the Amazon jungle, a documentary crew rescues a loner who turns out to be a man obsessed. Life becomes dangerous for them all as he attempts to capture a lethal 40ft anaconda...

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines

Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller, the sequel to Pitch Black, starring Vin Diesel. Antihero convict Riddick finds himself on the run from intergalactic bounty hunters, but when he seeks refuge on a strange planet he discovers that the place has been overrun by the all-powerful Necromongers, storm-troopers bent on universal annihilation.

An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin a' chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh, agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba 's e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people's skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick Stein travels to St Ives to meet one of Britain's little-known artists, Alfred Wallis. In the shadow of Bodmin Moor, Rick visits a very rare collection of medieval stained-glass windows in the church of St Neot. It is here he ticks off an item on his bucket list by taking part in a rather unusual celebration called Oak Apple Day, marking the occasion when Charles II became king.
And on the Cornish border with Devon, Rick meets a lamb farmer who is on a mission to rear the best lamb in the county, inspiring Rick to cook a delicious lamb stew called a Navarin.

programme.desc: Cornwall has more than its fair share of folktales. Perhaps the most famous is found near Land's End, where Rick recounts the tale of the Mermaid of Zennor. A short distance away, he joins a small army of seaweed harvesters who are feeding an increasing appetite for a natural food more common in Japan

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick roams the dramatic north Cornish coast to tell the story of one of Britain's best-loved writers, Thomas Hardy, and his little-known love affair with a Cornishwoman. programme.title: The Body in the Bag
programme.desc: The case of Gareth Williams, a GCHQ employee on secondment to MI6, who was found dead inside a padlocked duffel bag in the bath of his London flat in 2010. The case has become one of the biggest unsolved mysteries in recent British history, and even now, 12 years after Williams' death, the public are still waiting for answers as to what happened to the 31-year-old codebreaker. Through interviews with former detectives, forensic investigators, MPs and people who knew Gareth, along with archive footage and reconstruction, this documentary re-examines the case in a bid to get to the bottom of the events that lead to Williams' untimely death - asking did he act alone or were other forces involved?

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick Stein travels to St Ives to meet one of Britain's little-known artists, Alfred Wallis. In the shadow of Bodmin Moor, Rick visits a very rare collection of medieval stained-glass windows in the church of St Neot. It is here he ticks off an item on his bucket list by taking part in a rather unusual celebration called Oak Apple Day, marking the occasion when Charles II became king.
And on the Cornish border with Devon, Rick meets a lamb farmer who is on a mission to rear the best lamb in the county, inspiring Rick to cook a delicious lamb stew called a Navarin.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

Rick Stein travels to St Ives to meet one of Britain's little-known artists, Alfred Wallis. programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick is in Falmouth, discovering that far from being 'that bit on the end of Britain', Cornwall used to be at the very heart of the British Empire's communication system and is still very much a working port today.

For one man, the operation will be a life-changing experience.

The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. The Lions have played a home game on Thanksgiving Day almost every year since 1934, with the only exceptions being six years during World War II. The tradition began when then-owner George A. Richards wanted to build excitement and draw attention ahead of a match against the unbeaten Chicago Bears, and it proved to be so successful it was broadcast by 94 radio stations across the country, becoming the first-ever national NFL radio broadcast

programme.title: Live NFL
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys v Philadelphia Eagles (Kick-off 9.30pm). Coverage of the week 12 match from AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas. The Cowboys first played a Thanksgiving Day fixture in 1966 and have done so every year since then, except for 1975 and 1977. They come into this year's match having won in each of the last three years, including a 31-28 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs 12 months ago

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc:
Steve travels to the deadliest desert on the planet, the Baja peninsula in Mexico, where he goes searching for a gruesome savage killer in the form of a tarantula hawk wasp. This predator lays an egg in its tarantula prey, which hatches into a maggot, which then eats the spider from the inside - while it's still alive! It is the biggest wasp in the world and has a paralysing sting which makes even Steve nervous - that doesn't stop him handling it though.
The desert of Baja, Mexico, is serpent central and Steve has the time of his life catching snakes. These include a cape water snake, and a coachwhip snake that catches Steve unaware and lands a cheeky bite on his hand. He then embarks on a regular rattlesnake round-up, clocking up encounters with the venomous red diamond and Baja rattlesnakes before an encounter with a speckled rattlesnake tops off the best snake-hunting day Steve has ever had in his life.
Steve also takes to water in the Sea of Cortez in search of a monster of the deep seas. Known locally as the Red Devil, legend talks of its ability to snatch fishermen from their boats before tearing them to shreds - it is the Humboldt squid. Snatching fishermen is probably a little far-fetched, but Steve takes no chances and wears chain mail to protect him from the squid's razor-sharp beak and its 16 thousand sucker cup teeth.
Incidental finds which don't make it onto Steve's list are a mole lizard which looks like one of the oddest creatures on the planet and a torchlit walk in the local vicinity which reveals he and his crew are literally surround by scorpions.

programme.title: Celebrity Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Amanda Holden joins the team for a special episode for Scam Safe Week, in which she helps them go after the criminals who used her name and image to con victims out of thousands. Using the same remote access tech scammers rely on, the team will hack the hackers to monitor their operations in real time, before confronting the fraudsters, and stopping scams before they happen

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When Phil returns home to find someone hanging around his house, he decides to confront him and finds some incriminating evidence on his doorbell footage. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan takes a trip to a garden centre to highlight simple tips that can deter wannabe burglars. And Janet turns doorbell detective to foil an elaborate scam when she receives a brand new mobile phone.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk. With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Bing agus a charaidean a' tarraing dealbh do Gilly, tha Teàrlaidh a' cur sgròb mhòr air feadh an deilbh aige-san ach tha Gilly a sealltainn dhaibh nach b' e droch rud a bh' ann.
When Bing and his friends draw a picture for Gilly, Charlie does a squiggle on Bing's picture. But Gilly shows them that this is not such a bad thing.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Bing aig taigh Sula 'son Pàrtaidh Aodach-oichdh', tha e a' gabhail feagal nuair a tha e a' cluinntinn meanglan mòr, sgrìobach bho muigh. Ach, an uairsin, tha e ag ionnsachadh nach eil rudan eagallach cho eagallach sa shaoileas tu.
When Bing is at Sula's house for a PJ Party, he gets frightened when he hears a large scratchy branch outside. At the end of the day though, he learns that things aren't as scary as you think they are.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc:
Tha Hari air mìlsean bhlasta a bhèiceadh airson Ela agus Seren - cèic teòclaid! Bidh aon Abadas air a thaghadh airson a dhol a shealltainn airson rudeigin eile cruinn agus milis. Dè bhios ann?
Hari has prepared a yummy treat for Ela and Seren - a chocolate cake! One Abadas will be chosen to go on another exciting adventure looking for something round and sweet-smelling. What could it be?

programme.title: Cleasan Àtaidh & Tilidh (The Adventures of Abney & Teal)
programme.desc: Abney finds a hole in his roof. Then he starts to notice holes everywhere. He decides to dig one of his own, but gets stuck in it and needs help from Teal, Neep and the Poc-Pocs

programme.title: 'S E Iasg a Th'Annam (I'm a Fish)
programme.desc: The Tuna Fish tells us how speedy they are and how they are good hunters. They hunt with their friends, the dolphins, as the dolphins keep them safe from other predators

programme.title: Òrain CBeebies
programme.desc: A selection of seafaring songs from Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh and the CBeebies ALBA presenters

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Iain MacInnes reads Am Pàrtaidh Teatha aig Dadaidh by Mike Sperring, illustrated by Sarah Warburton and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: The Ugly Pageant is staged, where participants decide who the ugliest Bògais is

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: When Bonns is out finding food for his 12-course midnight snack, the Cnuimhean catch and kidnap him

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc: The Farmer decides to build a golf course on the farm to impress the local squire. The slock realise they will lose their beloved dump, so need to come up with an imaginative solution to save it

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: The little girl tries to resolve Daibhidh’s nightmares. There is something mysterious about the new girl on the street and her presence is not helping

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: The lads go out of their comfort zone and go plant-based. Uisdean starts off by preparing Seitan, a meat substitute made from wheat gluten. Ruaridh recreates a recipe he often cooks at home, having realised that his Moroccan chickpea stew is fully plant-based. He accompanies it with an excellent vegan flatbread. A bean burger is Uisdean's main dish, while Ruaridh makes vegan sausage rolls with home-made beans in tomato sauce. When the seitan has cooked and cooled down, Uisdean slices it up and makes an alternative to spicy chicken wings. The dish is accompanied by a sticky spicy sauce

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the first steps of speaking Gaelic, joined by studio guest Iain MacPherson who hails from Alberta, Canada. Plus, Calum Maclean visits a thriving community project in Glasgow

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: In the village of Appin, Gregor MacCormick shows his collection of vintage engines, and retired sea Captain Eric Smith visits the new lighthouse ship, the Pole Star

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Daisy receives emergency treatment for severe breathing problems, while Treasa and Ian welcome their twins and prepare to lose Joshua. Diane makes progress, and Méabh is transferred closer to home

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Zac, who has never settled into responsible adult life, receives an opportunity for pop stardom

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:
Tha Bagelean Abigail fìor bhlast' agus sònraicht' 'son bruinse no lòn, no fiù 's aig àm sam bith, 's 'ad gad shàsachadh ann an dòigh nach gabh inns' 's iad fèìr taght' 'son an roinn leis an teaghlach no le caraidean.
Abigail's bagels are a very special and tasty brunch or lunch, or anytime experience, satisfying to the extreme and just the thing to share with family and friends.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Spoof documentary. Angela clashes with angry locals shouting about short-term lets. There's a sticky situation when an activist sneaks through the catflap with a tube of superglue

programme.title: An t-Uisge (Rain Stories)
programme.desc: Anne Lundon visits one of Scotland's newest island distilleries to find out the connection between rainwater and the national drink, and learns of a frog wedding in India

programme.title: Dana - Europe's Wild Side
programme.desc: Situated within the Arctic Circle, Norway's Lofoten islands offer a lifetime's worth of exploration in the outdoors. Attracted by the world-class climbing and surfing on offer, Coinneach Rankin journeys around the islands with his companion, Calum Gibb, to glean once-in-a-lifetime experiences

After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

programme.title: George Best: All By Himself
programme.desc: Daniel Gordon's film charts the life of George Best, whose footballing skills gave him a celebrity that was the equal of the Beatles'. But despite his prodigious talent, Belfast-born Best struggled with inner demons that would ultimately undermine his career.

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, Bill Rich moves with his pregnant partner Liz and teenage son Jonathan to a remote farmhouse in the idyllic Brecon Beacons. On the very first night, Liz hears footsteps on the landing. Before long, Liz and Jonathan are sharing disturbing dreams, and as strange events intensify, the family is forced to accept a terrifying new reality. Fact-based supernatural drama, starring Gabrielle Creevy and Michael Socha

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: The family receive a shockingly high electricity bill and their animals start to behave oddly. Liz attends a mother and baby group where she meets spiritualist Bethan, who offers to conduct a seance. After a strained Christmas dinner, Jonathan admits he's also seen a ghost, while Liz and Bill beg Brecon Council for help, raising the suspicions of social services

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk interrogates some of the world's foremost filmmakers and critics, discovers an age of screen icons from Marilyn Monroe to Wayne John, and learns how Hollywood movies changed as American social values relaxed. She also gives her verdict on classics like Jaws, Taxi Driver, and Citizen Ken - very much the 'Citizen Kane' of films about people called Ken. Comedy, starring Diane Morgan

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress learns about the art of patisserie in Paris, which is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world, sampling the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and a dahlia

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman is in Gloucestershire with Sam and Mandy, who are moving from a harbour town in Devon and making a fresh start in the countryside, with their two much-loved dogs coming along for the adventure. Nicki also gets an invitation to experience horticulture on a truly regal scale when she visits a garden quite literally fit for a king

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Philippa, Nathan, Pete, Natalie and Sandra race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals

programme.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
programme.desc: Monty Don celebrates the rewards of winter gardening, sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding viewers that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there is always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Family members Sarah, Paul, Curtis and Jessica compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray and Edith Bowman discover tips and treats at the food and music festival in Newcastle. They find out how to create award-winning burgers and reveal the secrets of chips, French-Canadian style. Briony-May Williams goes on the trail of the nation's favourite herb and chef Julie Lin sets sail to find Scotland's most valuable fish. Farmer Meinir Howells investigates the growing popularity of keeping chickens

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels the length of the Northumbrian coastline, with its glorious beaches and grandiose castles. In the village of Alnmouth he takes to the waves in a traditional skiff built by members of the Alnmouth Coastal Rowing Club. His last stop of the day is the mighty Bamburgh Castle

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: Liz explores the volcanic islands of the Lesser Antilles, joining residents of Mayreau who are repairing their island's vibrant coral that has been damaged by disease. On neighbouring Union Island, Liz goes on patrol with an environmental army protecting the Union Island gecko, one of the smallest reptiles in the world and which was once one of the most trafficked reptiles in the Caribbean

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team make the show's first trip to Londonderry, where they value more objects brought in by the public. Among items displayed for their scrutiny are a set of intricate hand-cut pictures, a cushion woven from human hair and a collection of silver worth more than £100,000. First shown in 2006

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin, Will Axon and Philip Serrell visit Ickworth House, a Georgian mansion in Suffolk built for the Earls of Bristol, where the team picks out a selection of interesting items to be sold at auction. Will casts an appreciative eye over a piece of Martinware, but a miniature long case clock bought at the car boot for £1 could prove to be the star find. Paul also heads to the Suffolk coast to explore a fantasy holiday village built in the early 20th century

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Michael Sheen asks the questions as Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad face the penultimate round of challenges

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Costume designer Vicky Gill reveals what the couples will be wearing at the weekend, and Ellie Taylor has more backstage gossip

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Wanting a new start in Devon, a couple with a budget of £650,000 enlist Jules Hudson's house-hunting knowhow to find a detached family home with a large garden for their two young children and some income potential. While in the county, Jules gets stuck into some woodcraft using nothing but steam to sculpt some impressive interior design pieces

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: The presenter travels across the south west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens, thanks to the warm and wet climate. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones

programme.title: Why Sinkholes Collapse
programme.desc: On 24 September 2025, a massive sinkhole opened outside a Bangkok hospital, swallowing vehicles, damaging infrastructure and forcing nearly 1,000 people to evacuate. This film investigates its causes, exploring how collapsing tunnels, ageing sewers, abandoned mines, groundwater depletion and urban development contribute to the growing global threat of city sinkholes

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk heads to Hollywood, where she accosts some of the people behind the biggest movies of recent years, from The Avengers to Transformers. She takes a look at Star Wars, Jurassic Park, Toy Story, the home video revolution, the rise of the blockbuster franchise and the state of cinema today in the wake of the rise of artificial intelligence

programme.title: Newsnight

programme.desc: Bert and Harry launch a high-speed chase along narrow country roads near Portadown in pursuit of a dangerous driver, while Tom's patience is tested by an abusive suspect in Belfast. When Bingo makes Dad break the 'No Dancing' rule, he is fired. Seeing Dad sitting unhappily outside, the ribbiting Bingo encourages him to dance his troubles away and he impresses Mum's passing ballerina, who finds him a new career as a professional dancer.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: After Dad ignores Bingo, trouble comes to the Heelers house, which fills up with invisible mischief-making fairies. Tails are braided, Mum gets a peg beard and Dad's phone ends up in fairy dancing circle! Mum suspects someone hurt the fairies' feelings and sends Bingo to see what they want. Bingo leads the family to a message demanding Dad dance a jig around the letterbox in front of the neighbours. Dad refuses, but when the fairies freeze Bingo like a statue, he tells her not to worry - he would do anything for her. His merry jig finally pleases the fairies, unfreezes Bingo and saves the day.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bored of the overcrowded local playground, Dad leads Bluey, Bingo and Mackenzie on an adventure to discover their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey finds the weird bugs and untamed landscape intimidating at first. But as the natural wonder of the bush enchants her, she finds her resilience and inner strength with each passing step. By the time they reach the picturesque watering hole, Bluey is enraptured with the simple natural beauty that surrounds her. And after a well-deserved dip they return to civilization, with Bluey more confident than ever before.

programme.title: The Upper Hand

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond

Comedy, starring Peter Boyle, Doris Roberts, Ray Romano and Brad Garrett

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Amy chats non-stop through a basketball game, and Ray responds by suggesting to Robert that she talks too much - a criticism she does not take well. Comedy, starring Monica Horan and Ray Romano

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra cannot understand why Ray keeps turning down her advances - not realising that playing it cool is all part of his latest devious plan to get what he wants. Comedy, starring Ray Romano

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina's dreams of a wild college bash are dashed once her meddlesome aunts take matters into their own wands, conspiring with Sixties teen idol Frankie Avalon to conjure up a nice, healthy beach party. Supernatural sitcom, starring Melissa Joan Hart

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina's disruptive cousin Amanda is sent to Witchright Hall, a special school where magically challenged witches are taught to use their powers constructively in the mortal world. Melissa Joan Hart and Emily Hart star

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Ross goes to a spray-tanning salon, but his failure to follow the instructions leaves him with a complexion he was not looking for. Joey and Rachel prepare to sleep together for the first time, but the night proves more awkward than romantic. Guest starring Jennifer Coolidge

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Monica and Chandler decide to delay their trip to Vermont to celebrate Emma's first birthday, but the party takes an unexpected turn with the delivery of a risque birthday cake. Comedy, guest starring Elliott Gould

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Christina Applegate reprises her role as Rachel's clueless sister Amy, who offers to babysit Emma and ends up giving the unfortunate child a makeover. Phoebe inadvertently spoils Mike's anniversary surprise, and Joey writes a letter of recommendation for the Bings. Comedy, guest starring Christina Applegate and Paul Rudd

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Greg Kinnear guest stars as Charlie's Nobel Prize-winning old flame, who is overseeing a grant Ross desperately wants. Rachel and Monica try to foist on each other one of Phoebe's peculiar paintings. Comedy, guest starring Aisha Tyler (Archer) and Greg Kinnear (I Don't Know How She Does It)

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Ross discovers Rachel has an irrational fear of swings, while Phoebe and Mike argue about whether to give their wedding fund to charity. The Bings learn Joey had a one-night stand with the adoption worker handling their case, and worry he has ruined their chances

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Monica reluctantly agrees to cook Thanksgiving dinner, but the others all turn up late, so she and Chandler angrily lock them out - until an unexpected phone call changes their mood completely

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Monica and Chandler travel to Ohio to meet the mother of the baby they plan to adopt. The pregnant mother, Erica, likes them but only because their files got mixed up with a doctor and a female minister. Meanwhile, Joey is set up on a date with one of Phoebe's friends, but soon regrets it when she tries to take some food off his plate, and Ross has a fashion faux pas when he accidently wears women's clothing on a date

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Rachel and Phoebe see Chandler getting into a car with a mystery woman and follow them to a large house in the suburbs. They tell Monica of their fears and are shocked to hear the truth. Comedy, starring Jennifer Aniston, Lisa Kudrow and Matthew Perry

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Joey appears on quiz show The $100,000 Pyramid, but his disastrous efforts to answer the questions end up costing his partner the prize money. Meanwhile, the revellers at Phoebe's hen party get a surprise once the stripper shows up. Guest starring Danny DeVito and Donny Osmond

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Phoebe's big day arrives, but wedding planner Monica and stand-in father of the bride Joey take their roles a little too seriously. To make matters worse, a blizzard hits New York and one of Mike's ushers is indisposed, forcing Ross and Chandler to step into the breach

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Joey persuades Phoebe to teach him French for an important audition, while Monica and Chandler show a pregnant Erica the sights of New York and learn more about the baby's possible father. Guest starring Anna Faris and Ron Leibman

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Rachel heads to a restaurant for a job interview, only to find herself sitting at a table within earshot of her current boss. Meanwhile, Monica and Chandler go house-hunting and Phoebe decides to change her name. Guest starring Paul Rudd and Dakota Fanning

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Phoebe learns Joey's agent has died, but he is so upset about his friends moving away that she decides not to tell him. Rachel worries about relocating to France, while Monica and Chandler are horrified to discover Janice is planning to buy the house next door to them. Guest starring Jane Lynch (Glee)

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: The gang throws a going-away party for Rachel, but she prefers to say her goodbyes individually - and one of her friends is left feeling hurt at being overlooked. Meanwhile, Monica supervises the packing for a new life in the suburbs with Chandler, while also keeping a close eye on the mother of their future adopted child

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: Double bill. The last-ever episode of the comedy sees the pals facing major changes. There is a surprise in store for Monica and Chandler when Erica finally gives birth to the child they are planning to adopt, Phoebe and Mike decide to start a family of their own and Rachel gets set to begin a new life in Paris. Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry and David Schwimmer star

programme.title: Al Murray Live - Barrel of Fun
programme.desc: Stand-up from London's Hammersmith Apollo. Al Murray takes on topics including the difference between men and women, the Pope, and squirrels

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Satirical animation following the adventures of Stan, Cartman, Kenny and Kyle, who live in a town famed for its weird and inexplicable happenings. With the voices of Trey Parker and Matt Stone

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The 'Coon - Cartman's vigilante alter-ego - prepares to lead his team of heroes in finding a solution to the Gulf of Mexico oil spill, but another crime-fighter beats them to it, causing dissension to spread among the masked vigilante's ranks

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Charlotte Ritchie, Jamali Maddix, Lee Mack, Mike Wozniak and Sarah Kendall continue their quest to curry favour with omnipotent Taskmaster Greg Davies. Lee attacks a toy vole and Sarah invents a sweet dressing for an unusual salad. Meanwhile, Charlotte provides surprising sound effects for a set of Russian dolls. programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Best Bits

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, as Sean Lock and David Mitchell take on Jon Richardson and Sara Pascoe. Lexicographer Susie Dent is joined by Ellie White and Natasia Demetriou in Dictionary Corner, while maths whizz Rachel Riley looks after the numbers

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Charlotte Ritchie, Jamali Maddix, Lee Mack, Mike Wozniak and Sarah Kendall continue their quest to curry favour with omnipotent Taskmaster Greg Davies. programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Chicago-based hardware retailer True Value's CEO and president John Hartmann poses as a handyman taking part in a reality show to go incognito among his own workforce to see how he can extend the company's lifespan and improve the experiences of both customers and employees

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Bill Peduto, 60th Mayor of Pittsburgh, who comes from a proud family of Pennsylvania steel workers, goes incognito among his own workforce posing as a reality show contestant from Kentucky. In the 10 months since he was elected, many changes have been made in Pittsburgh and Bill wants to make sure they are effective and to hear directly from the city's employees

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: First to host from the West Midlands are free spirits Michelle and Carl, who present a menu based on home-grown produce. The second night sees dinner party newcomers Katie and Phil opt for an ambitious menu for their first ever dinner party. However, with potato rivalry, a disappointing dessert and Carl's jokes in full effect, have the hosts bitten off more than they can chew? Day three sees Petra and her Italian husband Sergio opt for Italian home-cooked food in their bid to win the £1,000

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Competitive couple Mike and Lisa kick off the competition in Worcester with an Italian menu inspired by their upcoming wedding in Sorrento. However, before the food is served, the hosts overhear Steve and his outspoken wife Linda criticising the table decorations. On day two Linda and Steve cook up a tried-and-tested homemade menu, but Lisa is looking to find fault with the food. Finally, expectations are high for married couple Paul and Paul, who take a risk in search of rewards

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Groom-to-be Jack has three weeks and £12,000 to organise the biggest magic show ever for his wedding day to Sarah. However, his fiancee wants nothing more than one day in her life when Jack and his magic take a back seat so that she can be the centre of attention

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Laid back groom Josh has just three weeks and £12,000 to pull off the perfect wedding for his bride-to-be Amy. She dreams of a peaceful day close to home with all her friends and family around her, but Josh has big plans for an ambitious beach wedding abroad

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The King of Montebello cannot wait to see what he can drum up this time around. Rene sniffs out a great locker, stepping over the competition to get it. Kenny does his best to fire up his profits, while Brandi can't see the potential in the units

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Back in Montebello, Brandi and her buddy set the wayback machine and discover a roaring good time. Darrell makes the most of the little he's got, while Kenny fills his piggy bank, while courting an unfamiliar pastime

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Courtland Gray, the COO of audio equipment manufacturer Peavey Electronics, is poised to take over the Mississippi-based company when his stepfather, founder and CEO Hartley Peavey, is ready to hand over the reins. As he prepares to take full responsibility for the firm, Courtland dons a disguise to go incognito among the staff and find out how the frontline employees really feel

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Todd Pedersen, CEO and founder of Vivint, a leading solar and home security business, based in Utah, goes undercover among his own workforce posing as a contestant on a reality show. He's proud to head an organisation that provides a fun and relaxed work environment, but now that the company is offering smart home technology, it's in competition with much larger organisations, and Todd wants to make sure it's fully prepared to take them on

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Kids struggle with old-fashioned things like postboxes and toddler twins play the blame game

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Kenny tries to honour the history of San Bernardino, recording a win along the way. Also, Brandi shows her literary prowess volume by volume.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Ivy and Pops go head-to-head, and when Brandi's secret weapon lands her more than she bargained for, Kenny swoops in to brighten up her day.

programme.title: Below Deck
programme.desc: Reality show following the lives of the crew on board a luxury yacht during charter season

programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to the Prohibition Grille in Everett, Washington, where he meets belly dancer-turned-restaurateur Rishi Brown, who is making all the wrong moves with her business. Distracted from the task of improving her menu by performing for customers, she's oblivious to the disastrous dishes being served from her own kitchen

programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Metal expert Dominic Chinea and wood restorer Will Kirk have the rare opportunity to work on a wooden travel trunk, used by a family of Polish refugees as they travelled the globe looking for a permanent place to call home. They eventually voyaged to Britain aboard the Empire Windrush in 1948, with all their possessions kept in the trunk.
Gil and Sue Duffy from Worcestershire have a precious parcel for the attention of ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay. The glass and resin trophy was created in honour of their daughter Krissy, who died at just 31 years of age. She was a keen horsewoman and classic car racing driver. An unfortunate accident caused a large section of glass to snap off the trophy, the resin horse head to fall off and the wooden plinth to get scuffed. Will helps with the plinth and sets about crafting a bespoke travel case to keep the trophy safe, while Kirsten has the tricky task of gluing the substantial glass pieces together.
Clockwork guru and vintage toy enthusiast Steve Fletcher is captivated when Martin and Richard Scott, from Lincolnshire, arrive bearing a 1940s toy gyroscope complete with the original box. The little plastic cyclist should pedal his bike when a cord is pulled, but he stalled 70 years ago and hasn't got going since. His plastic limbs and body are disintegrating and both the front wheel and mechanism are broken. Steve comes up with an ingenious plan to get this plucky cyclist back on his bike and race ready.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick is in Falmouth, discovering that far from being 'that bit on the end of Britain', Cornwall used to be at the very heart of the British Empire's communication system and is still very much a working port today.
It was the seas around Cornwall that inspired author William Golding to write his famous novel Lord of the Flies, and his daughter Judy tells Rick how her father was horrified by what he witnessed during the war. And Rick gets to enjoy dishes prepared for him by an innovative young chef called Andy Tuck, who cooks everything over wood - forget your BBQ, this is cooking with fire on a whole new level.

It was the seas around Cornwall that inspired author William Golding to write his famous novel Lord of the Flies, and his daughter Judy tells Rick how her father was horrified by what he witnessed during the war. And Rick gets to enjoy dishes prepared for him by an innovative young chef called Andy Tuck, who cooks everything over wood - forget your BBQ, this is cooking with fire on a whole new level.

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: Jeremy Isaacs' classic documentary explores the Second World War's powerful legacy. For many people the conflict was the most significant experience of their lives, but it also left millions dead - ordinary civilians and victims of persecution, as well as military casualties. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: Churchill's Bid to Abolish Britain
programme.desc: This ambitious, striking film tells an astonishing story which challenges our understanding of the Second World War and our perception of world-renowned leaders.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his railway journey from Newcastle to Loch Ness, steered by his 1930s Bradshaw's Guide. Stopping at Dundee, Michael heads for Glamis Castle, where Lady Elizabeth Bowes-Lyon, the Queen Mother, grew up. Michael hears about her happy childhood and how she later found sanctuary there, when King Edward VIII abdicated and she and Prince Albert unexpectedly became king and queen of the United Kingdom

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is at Elgin's port, the coastal town of Lossiemouth, where the Labour Party's first prime minister James Ramsay MacDonald was born. Nearby, Michael finds a remote boarding school established in the 1930s and famous today both for its unusual ideas and its royal former pupils. His penultimate stop is Inverness, where he uncovers the work of female photographer MEM Donaldson, who documented a Highland way of life that was rapidly disappearing. Michael's journey ends at Loch Ness, where he joins a Deep Scan research team scouring the deep for signs of the elusive monster

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the West Country between the wars, setting off from the Cornish seaside resort of St Ives and ending his first in the former mining village of St Day. He visits Britain's first studio pottery, where he attempts a decorative wax technique and feels the heat of the firing kiln. Michael also joins a family on holiday in a railway carriage called Harvey

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Cornwall's county town, Truro, heading to the historic estate of Trewithen, whose gardens were stocked from China by professional plant hunters commissioned by its owner. The Atlantic Coast branch line carries Michael north to Newquay, where he discovers a pioneering surfer and braves the waves on a belly board. In the nearby village of St Mawgan, Michael is introduced to the ancient Cornish sport of 'wrassling', which surged in popularity between the wars as part of a Cornish Celtic revival

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches Bodmin en route to Totnes, as he explores the West Country from St Ives to Salisbury Plain. Out on the rugged moor, Michael hears how the celebrated author Daphne du Maurier captivated readers between the wars with her tales of smuggling at the Jamaica Inn. In Devon, Michael takes the plunge at Plymouth's beautiful art deco Tinside Lido, while at Ivybridge, he boards a vehicle like no other to cross the causeway to Burgh Island, where a 1930s playboy built a splendid art deco party palace

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's exploration of the West Country continues in south Devon. He arrives in Paignton to investigate an extraordinarily high murder rate in the literature of the 1930s. The Dartmouth Steam Railway conveys him in style to the beautiful home of Agatha Christie, in the company of her great-grandson, James Prichard

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo crosses the county line from Devon into Somerset, seeing first-hand how willow farmers sought to overcome the challenge from the production of synthetic plastics during the 1930s and hearing how tourism has spread across the region, especially amongst the young. In Bath, Michael visits the former home of a refugee emperor, whose country was invaded by the Italian dictator Mussolini, and in whose name a religious movement began that now flourishes worldwide. Travelling east into Wiltshire, he reaches the largest training area of the British Army, Salisbury Plain

programme.title: Wild Metropolis
programme.desc: Animals that travel in and out of cities in search of food or a safe place for their young. African penguins have found the streets of Cape Town a safe environment from predators, while still providing easy access to their fishing grounds, while in St Lucia, hippos have developed a taste for eating residents' lawns. Black bears roam the streets of cities across North America, seeking out discarded food to help them consume the 20,000 calories a day they need to survive their six-month hibernation

programme.title: Wild Metropolis
programme.desc: Animals displaced from their habitats by human expansion, including elephants in Sri Lanka and capuchin monkeys on the Pacific coast of Costa Rica. The programme also examines situations where humans have learned to live alongside their animal neighbours, including a heron that has been visiting an Amsterdam house twice a day for 17 years and a project to preserve manatees in Florida that has saved them from being an endangered species

programme.title: Attenborough and the Mammoth Graveyard
programme.desc: David Attenborough joins a team of archaeologists and palaeontologists excavating a mammoth graveyard discovered by fossil hunters in the prehistoric riverbed of the Thames. programme.desc: Jeremy Isaacs' classic documentary explores the Second World War's powerful legacy.
